details.description: Kimi K2 Thinking is Moonshot AI's reasoning-focused chat and agent model, sharing Kimi K2's 1-trillion-parameter, 32-billion-activated mixture-of-experts architecture but adding an interleaved chain-of-thought 'thinking' mode that reasons between tool calls. Moonshot's model card states it maintains coherent, goal-directed behavior across 200-300 consecutive tool invocations, versus 30-50 steps in prior models, and it ships with native INT4 post-training quantization on its MoE layers for roughly a 2x speed-up in low-latency inference. It takes text-only input and is released under a Modified MIT License. Moonshot's own API platform lists this model's hosted endpoints as discontinued since May 25, 2026 in favor of its newer Kimi K3 model.
advantages: Scores 71.3% on SWE-bench Verified with tools, per Moonshot's model card.
Scores 99.1% on AIME 2025 when allowed to use Python (94.5% without tools), per Moonshot's model card.
Scores 60.2% on BrowseComp with tools, per Moonshot's model card.
Scores 44.9% on Humanity's Last Exam with tools (51.0% in Moonshot's 'heavy' parallel-sampling mode), per Moonshot's model card.
Scores 84.6% on MMLU-Pro and 94.4% on MMLU-Redux, per Moonshot's model card.
Native INT4 quantization-aware training gives roughly a 2x generation speed-up in low-latency mode while Moonshot reports it as near-lossless on quality.
disadvantages: Text-only: no vision/image input, per the catalog's modality and Moonshot's model card.
Score on Humanity's Last Exam drops to 23.9% without tool access, versus 44.9% with tools, per Moonshot's model card.
Moonshot's own card notes the hosted chat mode on kimi.com uses a reduced tool subset and fewer steps than the benchmarked configuration.

Moonshot's own API platform lists the matching hosted endpoints ('kimi-k2-thinking', 'kimi-k2-thinking-turbo') as discontinued since May 25, 2026, directing users to the newer Kimi K3 model, per Moonshot's Model List page.
use_cases: Deep-research agents that browse the web and call tools across long multi-step tasks.
Autonomous coding agents needing sustained multi-step tool use.
Competition math and STEM problem solving.
Long-horizon agentic workflows requiring hundreds of coherent tool calls.

notes: This target groups nine Bedrock region/vendor-prefix ids (using both 'moonshot.' and 'moonshotai.' vendor prefixes) plus a Fireworks id, all for the same model. Catalog's max_input_tokens carries two values (256000, 262144) and max_output_tokens two values (16000, 262144); kept as given rather than restated as one number. No dedicated GitHub repository found (github.com/MoonshotAI/Kimi-K2-Thinking returns 404, and it is absent from the MoonshotAI GitHub org's repo list too), so github_url is null; code/inference guidance is published on the Hugging Face card instead. No explicit release date found stated on the model card itself. Catalog has no deprecation_date, but Moonshot's own current API docs (platform.kimi.ai/docs/models) list 'kimi-k2-thinking' and 'kimi-k2-thinking-turbo' among models discontinued since May 25, 2026, recommending Kimi K3; this governs Moonshot's own first-party API only, and the open-weight checkpoint remains independently servable through the Bedrock and Fireworks routes this catalog target actually uses, so I did not call the model itself deprecated.
